findings.issue_text: get_item_key() applies math.floor/math.ceil directly to a datetime value, causing every non-empty optimized request to raise TypeError while building response cursors
value_from_cursor() leaves the cursor numeric, causing subsequent pages to compare a datetime database column with an integer instead of a timezone-aware datetime
The advanced path passes negative offsets into a Django QuerySet slice, allowing a negative-offset cursor to trigger a 500 because Django rejects negative slicing

goldens.comment: The OptimizedCursorPaginator in organization_auditlogs.py attempts to use negative slice offsets on Django querysets, but Django querysets do not support negative slicing and will raise an AssertionError.

When requests are authenticated with API keys or org auth tokens (which have user_id=None), organization_context.member is None. Line 71 attempts to access organization_context.member.has_global_access without checking if member is None, causing an AttributeError crash when optimized_pagination=true is used, even though the request passed all permission checks with valid org:write scope.
get_item_key assumes a numeric key, but the paginator is used with order_by=-datetime in the audit logs endpoint; calling math.floor/ceil on a datetime will raise a TypeError.

adjudication_records.issue_text: value_from_cursor() leaves the cursor numeric, causing subsequent pages to compare a datetime database column with an integer instead of a timezone-aware datetime

adjudication.rationale: The OptimizedCursorPaginator's value_from_cursor() method at line 843 simply returns cursor.value as-is (return cursor.value), which is an integer. This paginator is used for audit logs ordered by '-datetime'. When build_queryset() uses this integer cursor_value to filter against the datetime column, it will compare a datetime database column with an integer instead of a timezone-aware datetime. The DateTimePaginator (which this is replacing in certain cases) has proper datetime conversion in its value_from_cursor method, but OptimizedCursorPaginator lacks this conversion, causing type mismatch issues in subsequent pagination queries.
